fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Work & Share has moved into Nanterre, at 5 boulevard des Bouvets, in a modern, friendly setting a stone’s throw from La Défense.

Ideally located near the Nanterre courthouse and the Paris La Défense Arena, the space offers a lively, welcoming work environment designed to meet the needs of every business — from small companies to large, growing teams.

With 34 private offices, open-plan spaces and 4 meeting rooms, everything is designed to boost productivity and collaboration. The space also hosts business events for up to 150 attendees: seminars, workshops or conferences.

In the Delta building, enjoy a reception and concierge service, as well as a restaurant and café offering a varied, balanced food selection. Just 2 minutes’ walk from the RER A, Work & Share Nanterre combines accessibility, comfort and conviviality every day.

• Patio — For a well-deserved break in the fresh air
  • Restaurant and café — Sit-down lunch, alone or with your team

Located at 1 place Louis Renault in Rueil-Malmaison, in the heart of the Rueil-sur-Seine district, Work & Share Rueil-Malmaison offers 1,510 m² of coworking space, flexible offices and rooms for meetings and business events.

Designed as a guesthouse for entrepreneurs, our space hosts nearly 250 workstations across private offices, managed offices for large teams and coworking desks, in the Online building — a new-generation building certified HQE Excellent and BREEAM Very Good.

Residents enjoy a complete environment for working and meeting people: fully equipped meeting rooms, phone booths, social areas, plus many services in the building (shared company restaurant, green atrium, terraces, car park, bike storage…).

Easy access: Rueil-Malmaison station (RER A) right nearby, with quick access to the A86 and La Défense. Work & Share also has a second space in Rueil-Malmaison, for a total of nearly 5,000 m² in the town.

fieldData.l-espace-en-quelques-mots:
Situé 1 place Louis Renault à Rueil-Malmaison, au cœur du quartier Rueil-sur-Seine, Work & Share Rueil-Malmaison propose 1 510 m² d’espaces de coworking, de bureaux flexibles et de salles dédiées aux réunions et événements professionnels.

Pensé comme une maison d’hôtes pour entrepreneurs, notre espace accueille près de 250 postes de travail répartis entre bureaux privatifs, bureaux opérés pour grandes équipes et postes en coworking, dans l’immeuble Online — un bâtiment nouvelle génération certifié HQE Excellent et BREEAM Very Good.

Les résidents profitent d’un environnement complet pour travailler et se rencontrer : salles de réunion équipées, phonebox, espaces de convivialité, ainsi que de nombreux services dans l’immeuble (restaurant inter-entreprises, atrium végétalisé, terrasses, parking, local vélos…).

Accès facile : gare Rueil-Malmaison (RER A) à proximité immédiate, accès rapide à l’A86 et à La Défense. Work & Share dispose également d’un second espace à Rueil-Malmaison, pour un total de près de 5 000 m² dans la ville.
